source_context: Native Clematis drummondii near Mission, Hidalgo County, by sonnia hill, CC BY 2.0. Follow the LEAF STALK (petiole/rachis) wrapped around a support; Clematis climbs by flexible leaf stalks, not by a separate tendril. A lobed leaf is visible beside it; don't interpret the loop as a new tendril.
